title: vicar-lab-intro
caption: Robotics & AI in marine science research at the University of the Virgin Islands. The first robotics and AI lab in the U.S. Caribbean.

title: grouper-spawning
caption: Ecologically important grouper species, including the critically endangered Nassau Grouper, gather in large groups to spawn south of St. Thomas.

title: salt-river-deep
caption: Salt River Deep. A 30 m mesophotic reef on the steep canyon wall off the north shore of St. Croix. Once home to the famous underwater habitats HYDROLAB (1977-85) and Aquarius (1986-89).

title: bleaching-event
caption: The 2023/2024 mass bleaching event. A diver above a bleached Caribbean reef during the 4th Global Coral Bleaching Event.

title: rangerbot-fish-study
caption: RangerBot, a compact reef-survey AUV from Queensland University of Technology with stereo vision and onboard target detection. Here UVI researchers use it to study fish. The robot is moving on its own. No one is driving.

title: hydrus-deployment
caption: Hydrus, a compact 300 m photogrammetry AUV from Advanced Navigation, hand-launched at sea. Small AUVs go where divers and ships cannot. Paired with Subsonus USBL for AI-assisted photogrammetric surveys at mesophotic depths.

title: dvl-integration
caption: Installing a Doppler Velocity Log on the BlueROV2, the lab's tethered workhorse for site inspections and shakedown dives. The DVL adds precision navigation in the absence of GPS. The unglamorous work behind autonomy.

title: tcrmp-divers
caption: TCRMP. Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program. Divers ascending from surveys at Cane Bay Deep, Spring 2026. UVI researchers collect data and video on USVI reefs every year.

title: reef-monitoring
caption: UVI researchers also collect data and record video on USVI coral reefs every year. The long-term record that makes change detection possible.

title: tcrmp-orthos
caption: Ortho-mosaics from diver imagery. 3D photogrammetric reconstructions of TCRMP reef sites at millimeter resolution. Each model is built from thousands of overlapping frames.

title: auv-dem-flythrough
caption: Georeferenced DEMs from AUVs. Digital elevation models of a Caribbean reef section, reconstructed from AUV imagery, covering ground a diver pair could not reach.

title: robots-and-divers
caption: Robots will work alongside UVI technical divers to collect imagery for mapping. Together they expand what a single dive can cover.

title: bleaching-tracking
caption: 3D map of a bleached coral reef using handheld cameras. Meri Shoal, Transect 2, November 2023. Repeat photogrammetry turns "the reef bleached" into per-colony trajectories of mortality, recovery, and replacement.

title: ai-from-robots
caption: AI models help speed up identifications from imagery collected by robots.

title: fish-tracking
caption: Computer-vision models follow individual fish across underwater video. Hours of footage turn into structured data, and scientists are freed for analysis.

title: ai-corals
caption: AI models also help with the tedious work of identifying corals and other reef organisms. At scale, across the archive.

title: vicar-lab-team
caption: The VICAR Lab, Virgin Islands Center for Autonomous Research. The first robotics and AI lab in the U.S. Caribbean, home of the VICARIUS in-house vehicle program for mesophotic missions, with sensors and software developed alongside the science.

title: automation-conservation
caption: Automation, through robotics and AI, is helping us research and conserve USVI ecosystems.

title: VID_2_GlidersI
caption: UVI’s ocean glider lab deploys large Slocum Gliders for extended missions.
